metadata.question: Was the vegetation cover near the Rosetta branch of the Nile mouth greater in 1984 than in 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Landsat 5 for 1984; Landsat 8 for 2021 (they overlap spectrally). - Date windows: 1984-01-01 → 1984-12-31 (LT05) 2021-01-01 → 2021-12-31 (LC08) - Location: single point on the Rosetta branch mouth (≈ 31.48° N, 30.25° E). 2. Masking strategy: - Use QA pixel bit-mask for both collections (cloud bits 3+5, plus cloud-shadow bit 6). - Compute NDVI for green vegetation proxy → NDVI = (NIR - RED)/(NIR + RED). 3. Logic to decide: - If either collection size == 0 → C1. - After masking, if valid-pixel count == 0 → C2. - If meanNDVI is None/NaN → C3. - Otherwise compare mean NDVI 1984 vs 2021 → A (greater) / B (not greater). ```python import ee, datetime ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') pt = ee.Geometry.Point(30.25, 31.48) # Rosetta mouth def ndvi_lta(col): qa = col.select('QA_PIXEL') mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).Or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5)).Or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 6)).Not() ndvi = col.normalizedDifference(['B4','B3']).rename('NDVI').updateMask(mask) return ndvi col84 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(pt).filterDate('1984-01-01','1984-12-31') col21 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(pt).filterDate('2021-01-01','2021-12-31') n84,n21 = [c.size().getInfo() for c in [col84,col21]] if n84==0 or n21==0: print("C1"); print("C1"); exit() med84 = ndvi_lta(col84).mean() med21 = ndvi_lta(col21).mean() v84,p84 = ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs=True).reduceRegion( image=med84, geometry=pt, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo() v21,p21 = ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs=True).reduceRegion( image=med21, geometry=pt, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo() print(f"1984 NDVI: {v84:.3f} (pixels {int(p84)}) 2021 NDVI: {v21:.3f} (pixels {int(p21)})") if p84==0 or p21==0: print("C2") elif v84 is None or v21 is None or v84!=v84 or v21!=v21: print("C3") else: print("A" if v84>v21 else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee, datetime
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

pt = ee.Geometry.Point(30.25, 31.48)  # Rosetta mouth

def ndvi_lta(col):
    qa = col.select('QA_PIXEL')
    mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).Or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5)).Or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 6)).Not()
    ndvi = col.normalizedDifference(['B4','B3']).rename('NDVI').updateMask(mask)
    return ndvi

col84 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(pt).filterDate('1984-01-01','1984-12-31')
col21 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(pt).filterDate('2021-01-01','2021-12-31')

n84,n21 = [c.size().getInfo() for c in [col84,col21]]
if n84==0 or n21==0:
    print("C1"); print("<answer>C1</answer>"); exit()

med84 = ndvi_lta(col84).mean()
med21 = ndvi_lta(col21).mean()

v84,p84 = ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs=True).reduceRegion(
            image=med84, geometry=pt, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo()
v21,p21 = ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs=True).reduceRegion(
            image=med21, geometry=pt, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('NDVI').getInfo()

print(f"1984 NDVI: {v84:.3f} (pixels {int(p84)})  2021 NDVI: {v21:.3f} (pixels {int(p21)})")
if p84==0 or p21==0: print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif v84 is None or v21 is None or v84!=v84 or v21!=v21: print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else: print("<answer>A</answer>" if v84>v21 else "<answer>B</answer>")
